steps.title: Configure WebSuite App Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application credentials, package structure, and target name.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Create build.gradle using native Java 8 specifications and API target level 34.

steps.title: Create WebSuite Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions, hardware acceleration, and the application theme.

steps.title: Design Button Background Drawable
steps.description: Create a round-cornered background drawable for retry and navigation buttons.

steps.title: Design App Main Layout
steps.description: Draft activity_main.xml layout to hold a custom app toolbar, page load progress indicator, the core WebView client, and an elegant offline warning layout.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Core
steps.description: Develop MainActivity.java to configure WebView, enable DOM storage, handle page events, and manage loading states.

steps.title: Implement Navigation Controls
steps.description: Attach click listeners to toolbar widgets in MainActivity.java to allow back, forward, refresh, and home navigation.

steps.title: Implement Network Validation & Retry Mechanism
steps.description: Integrate robust network connectivity checks, automatic error pages, and a retry button action to recover on network status changes.

steps.title: Building WebSuite
steps.description: Assemble the application build and complete standard verification.
